service_needs_quantity_and_price.name: service_needs_quantity_and_price
service_needs_quantity_and_price.value:
("ledger_entries"."service_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("ledger_entries"."quantity_hundredths" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."unit_price_cents" IS NOT NULL)

user_employment_order.name: user_employment_order
user_employment_order.value: "users"."ended_on" IS NULL OR "users"."started_on" IS NULL OR "users"."ended_on" >= "users"."started_on"

vacancy_steps_ordered.name: vacancy_steps_ordered
vacancy_steps_ordered.value: "vacancies"."salary_step_min" IS NULL OR "vacancies"."salary_step_max" IS NULL OR "vacancies"."salary_step_max" >= "vacancies"."salary_step_min"

vacancy_steps_positive.name: vacancy_steps_positive
vacancy_steps_positive.value: ("vacancies"."salary_step_min" IS NULL OR "vacancies"."salary_step_min" > 0) AND ("vacancies"."salary_step_max" IS NULL OR "vacancies"."salary_step_max" > 0)

vacancy_closed_after_opened.name: vacancy_closed_after_opened
vacancy_closed_after_opened.value: "vacancies"."closed_on" IS NULL OR "vacancies"."opened_on" IS NULL OR "vacancies"."closed_on" >= "vacancies"."opened_on"
